description: Returns the edition of one USCIS form that USCIS accepts today, with its accept-from and reject-from dates. Use it to check which edition of a form USCIS accepts, with the date of that answer. If USCIS has announced a newer edition it does not accept yet, announced_edition gives that edition and its accept-from date. For edition changes across all forms since a date, use list_form_changes. Covers I-90, I-129, I-130, I-131, I-140, I-485, I-539, I-765, and N-400; any other form returns not_found. Free, no sign-in required. Limit: 20 calls per minute per IP, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: the form's page on uscis.gov, or a dated web.archive.org capture of that page.

form.description: USCIS form number exactly as USCIS writes it, uppercase with the hyphen, e.g. "I-765". "i765" and "I765" do not match

name: check_form_edition

accept_from.description: First date USCIS accepts this edition, YYYY-MM-DD

announced_edition.description: The next edition USCIS has announced but does not accept yet; absent when none

edition_date.description: Edition date printed on the form, MM/DD/YY

reject_from.description: Date USCIS stops accepting this edition, YYYY-MM-DD; null when none is announced

title: Check form edition
